description: This Java source file defines the 'NotesHelper' class, which provides helper methods for managing notes associated with different entities (clients, groups, loans, loan transactions, savings) in the Fineract API. It contains static methods to create, retrieve, update, and delete notes for various resource types, utilizing REST API calls. The class also includes some deprecated methods indicating a transition to a different client approach.
